postal_system.assignment_rule: Swiss Post postcode/place and street-directory evidence defines PLZ4 assignment in the shared Swiss-Liechtenstein system. Liechtensteinische Post supplies local delivery and endpoint evidence; syntax or an endpoint listing alone never proves a domicile assignment.
postal_system.plz6_rule: swisstopo PLZO PLZ6 combines PLZ4 with a two-digit locality suffix and remains separately stored from the public four-digit address code.
postal_system.perimeter_rule: The swisstopo official directory publishes monthly locality and PLZ6 perimeters for domicile-address postcode types in Switzerland and Liechtenstein. Company, professional, administrative, PO-box, parcel-terminal, and other special codes may remain non-areal.
postal_system.m2_geometry_rule: The 2026-08-11 swisstopo STAC edition supplies 13 official REAL PLZ6 suffix-00 Polygon features. Official municipality BFS codes 7001-7011 and ZIP_ID joins partition LI rows before EPSG:2056 to EPSG:4326 conversion; no address, building or special-code area is inferred.
postal_system.address_rule: The Liechtenstein National Administration official building-address directory supplies street, house number, postcode, locality, coordinates, and Gebäudeidentifikator evidence. It does not replace Swiss Post postal assignment authority.
postal_system.building_rule: The public GWR and municipal official-survey packages supply building identity and geometry. Exact display requires the same official building identifier or a reviewed explicit crosswalk; containment and proximity remain candidates.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Official sovereign and municipal boundaries supply jurisdiction context and country partitioning but never replace a PLZO perimeter.
postal_system.territory_rule: A shared CH-LI source release must be filtered with authoritative country and sovereign-boundary evidence. Switzerland and Austria features must never enter the LI artifact, and LI rows must never receive CH AGID identity.

temporal_model.valid_time: Postal, address, building, and boundary validity when supplied by the source.
temporal_model.known_time: Source publication, ingest, correction, and release timestamps retained independently.
temporal_model.history_rule: Monthly PLZO and government registry changes append versioned evidence; a later assignment never rewrites an earlier release.

quality_gates.pass: Each PLZ4 assignment references a pinned Swiss Post receipt or permitted source edition and retains its postcode class.
Each domicile perimeter retains PLZ4, PLZ6, locality, release, rights, digest, and authoritative LI partition evidence.
Each official address retains the government building identifier, status, coordinates, CRS, source release, and attribution.
An exact building result has the same official building identifier or a reviewed explicit crosswalk; spatial proximity is candidate-only.
Every artifact is inside the authoritative LI partition and contains no CH or AT address, perimeter, building, or AGID identity.
No recipient, resident, owner, tenant, dwelling occupant, forwarding record, phone, credential, or protected register field is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights, coverage, and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

The current rights-cleared swisstopo PLZO edition reproduces all official LI domicile PLZ4 polygons with country-partition, lineage and topology evidence; the real API search reaches map fit, translucent fill, clear and re-search while non-area special codes remain explicit.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
